name: io.github.danishfareed/linkedin-mcp
title: LinkedIn MCP
description: Run your LinkedIn from an AI assistant: post, schedule, analytics, comments, jobs. Safe by default.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_MCP_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Simulate write actions (posts, comments, messages) without sending anything.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Hide every tool that can send something to LinkedIn.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_MCP_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to watch the browser while the assistant works.

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_MCP_WORKING_HOURS
environmentVariables.description: Local hours when write actions may run, e.g. 08:00-21:00, or off.
